extension.name: MetaData
extension.author: Nik Trevallyn-Jones
extension.description: Store meta-data in an AOI scene file
extension.comments: This plugin allows other plugins to store non-modelling data inside an AOI scene file.

history.log: - Changes for AOI 2.5 compatibility - Moved version to 1.0
- implemented MetaObject.find() and corresponding MetaData.FIND message - changes for compatability with new argument to Xlate.copy() methods
- changed how scrollbars are handled in GUI
